messages:
Izzy (CS): Drafting a tiny customer-facing handoff note: 'Priming jitter + stabilize-token' — aim is to reduce cold-starts while avoiding synchronized prefills that spike capacity. Want a short AM script, ops knobs, and feedback capture hooks. PTAL.

Rafael (AM): Love the focus on jitter. Real ask from field: customers hate demo flakiness. Can we include a one-line customer message AMs can paste?

Izzy (CS): Yup. Proposed AM paste: "We ran a gentle warmup so the demo stays snappy — tell me if latency or outputs look off and Ill dial it down."

Kim (SRE): Ops guidance: always randomize prefill start within a jitter window to avoid herd. Defaults I recommend: 
- trial: 3 prefills over 8m, jitter window 0-90s
- paid-sm: 12 prefills over 30m, jitter window 0-180s
- paid-lg: 40 prefills over 60m, jitter window 0-300s
Keep priming TTL 5m default, upgrade to 1h after sustained traffic.

Dana (PM): New primitive idea: 'stabilize_token' — a short-lived flag (boolean + ttl) that reserves a small safety budget and marks tenant for prioritized follow-up during renewal windows. Use it for at-risk customers during demos.

Rafael (AM): Nice. Where do we capture feedback? I want a tiny taxonomy and a place in the console to add a one-line summary.

Izzy (CS): Capture plan: 1) 24h micro-survey (3 quick checkboxes: latency/quality/cost), 2) single-line AM note field (max 200 chars) for immediate context, 3) automated daily sample diff on 10 canonical prompts. If quality delta > 4% on critical prompts -> escalate.

Kim (SRE): Pasteable batching/prefill snippet for the handout: 
```
# priming + batching defaults
priming:
  count: 12            # example for paid-sm
  window_min: 30
  jitter_sec_range: 0-180
  ttl_min: 5
  extend_after_sustained_min: 60

batching:
  warm_window_ms: 30
  steady_window_ms: 7
  max_batch_tokens: 2048

safety_budget_pct: 3  # reserved for stabilize_token demos
```

Izzy (CS): AM script (2 lines): 
- "Wereturned a small warmup to keep demos snappy."
- "If anything seems off (latency/quality/cost) I can drop the warmup or switch to a smaller model in a minute."

Rafael (AM): For stabilize_token: example JSON I can use to request it from support: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "cust_789",
  "stabilize_token": true,
  "stabilize_expires_at": "2025-06-01T12:00:00Z",
  "reserved_demo_pct": 4
}
```

Dana (PM): Monitoring & alerting to include in runbook: watch p50/p95/p99 latency, kv_cache_hit%, priming_completion_rate, jitter_spread_effectiveness (new metric: prefills that started > jitter_range midpoint), and stabilize_token_consumption. Suggested alerts: p99 > 2x baseline for >3m -> notify SRE + AM; quality delta > 4% on canonical set -> notify AM.

Kim (SRE): Troubleshooting quick bullets for AMs: 
- If p99 spikes: check recent prefills start times (were many synchronous?), validate jitter config, check model fallback events.
- If kv_cache_hit% low: ensure top intents are enabled for prefix caching and sample cadence is sufficient.
- If stabilize_token drains quickly: inspect demo routing and reserved quota bump config.

Izzy (CS): Feedback taxonomy for AMs: #latency, #quality, #cost, #demo-ux. Copyable tag list to paste on account note. Tagging triggers automated checks: #quality -> run daily sample diff, #latency -> run p99 spike check, #cost -> run reserved demo consumption audit.

Rafael (AM): I'll test the AM paste and the stabilize_token JSON on two pilot accounts this week and post verbatim feedback here.

onboard-bot: Created doc 'priming-jitter-and-stabilize-token-handbook' in /docs  please review.

Izzy (CS): Thanks all. If staging results look good we'll add this one-pager to the onboarding kit and ship a Slack paste for AMs by EOD Friday.

Kim (SRE): I'll run a staggered prefills test in staging tonight and post logs (including jitter distribution) back here.
